column1: # Format = gadconv RebrandTable: FROM<TAB>TO[<TAB>FLAGS], literal (no regex), applied in file order to every
# NUL-terminated cache string (configs, IF3 component texts/ops/string hook args, clientscript op-3 constants).
# FLAGS: i = ignore case, w = whole word only. Use it as: gadconv build-cacheu ... --rebrand.table=<this file>
# Scan used to build it (StrScan, regex near[ _.-]?reality|nearreality|osnr|roat ?pkz|runespawn|rune spawn):
#   user 211 cache (inputs/gadcache/x/cache/data/cache), archives 2 3 12: 14 hits, listed below with their place;
#   archives 6 8-11 13-21: 0 hits.  Stock openrs2 2746 (audit/raids4/c2746/cache) archives 2 3 12: 0 hits, so the
#   generic rules at the end cannot touch stock text.  cacheU has the same 14 hits at the same ids.
# After the build, rescan the output with the same regex: expected 0 hits.
# ---- exact strings, one per cache place (old -> new) ----
# obj 32080 name (archive 2 group 10 file 32080) and its placeholder obj 33080 (same name). Broadcast by
# GadScapeLaunchBox when a rare reward is opened, so players see it in world messages.
# struct 10327 string param (archive 2 group 34 file 10327): Advent Calendar day 1 task text
# interface 5004 component 1 text (archive 3 group 5004 file 1): Remnant Exchange title
# interface 5101 component 39 text (archive 3 group 5101 file 39): Credit Store, "credit packages" layer
# interface 5006 component 39 text (archive 3 group 5006 file 39): old store (dead, no server binding)
# interface 5103 component 5 text (archive 3 group 5103 file 5): Blackjack title
# clientscript 10504 op-3 string (instruction 18): title of the Teleports menu, interface 1601 (hook 1601:1)
# clientscript 12575 op-3 string (instruction 5): title of Remnant Perks, interface 866 (onload 866:0)
# clientscript 32000 op-3 string (instruction 14): title of the Voting Hub, interface 5100 (onload 5100:0)
# clientscript 32008 op-3 string (instruction 2): title of the Credit Store, interface 5101 (hook 5101:1)
# clientscript 12538 op-3 string: same title in the dead old-store script cluster 12538-12574
# clientscript 32036 op-3 string (instruction 5): title of Credit Packages, interface 5102 (onload 5102:0)
# clientscript 12566 op-3 string: same title in the dead old-store script cluster
# ---- generic fallbacks (catch anything a future user cache brings in) ----
# web addresses first, then the names; longest first.
